question.text: Amongst the following compounds, the one(s) which readily react with ethanolic KCN.

solution.text: (a) Ethyl chioride gives ethyl cyanide, when it reacts with KCN (ethanolic). $$ \mathrm{C}_{2} \mathrm{H}_{5} \mathrm{Cl}+\mathrm{KCN} \stackrel{\text { EThande }}{\longrightarrow} \mathrm{C}_{2}\mathrm{H}_{\mathrm{s}}-\mathrm{CN} $$ (b) It does not react with KCN. (c) Benzaldehyde : KCN gives HCN in alcoholic medium and HCN gives cyanohydrin with benzaldehyde.
